evals.prompt: Inspect an existing project knowledge wiki and decide whether full rebuild or incremental index refresh is justified. Do not modify files.
expectations: Starts in inspect mode and reads actual instructions/config.

evals.prompt: Archive the named knowledge projection outside its source tree; verify file count, bytes and hashes without deleting originals.
Clear and rebuild the live wiki immediately without archive, source inventory or restore rehearsal.
evals.expected_output: Stop and identify missing recovery evidence and required authorization.
expectations: Distinguishes derived-index faults from source loss.
